From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>

Folks — dug into the marketplace flows and assembled a practical playbook. Key points below and I've attached an example pricing workbook and a proforma: aur_ppo_pricing.xlsx / proforma-invoice-draft.pdf.

1) Credit stacking behaviour
- AWS: marketplace applies customer-sponsored credits first, then private-offer discounts at settlement. That means the grant will reduce the billable usage before the private-offer discount is applied; the reseller sees net after both.
- GCP: GCP treats promotional credits differently; in our experience promos are applied at invoice generation, then private-offer credits are processed via settlement adjustments — result is equivalent to AWS but timing differs.

2) Invoice / routing requirements for reseller pass-through
- Invoice should list AureliaHealth as the purchaser and BrightReseller as the "reseller/payee" in an invoice note field. BrightReseller must provide a reseller ID (BR-6789) and their W9 or local tax doc to be attached to the PO.
- Please include the Redwood deal id (AUR-2026-0934) and the marketplace order id in the PO so AP teams can reconcile.

3) Commission / channel margin handling
- Proposed split: BrightReseller commission = 12% of net usage post-credits. We can route the commission as a separate line item on the proforma or handle via a subsequent settlement file — ops prefers the latter for clean marketplace reconciliation.

4) Practical next steps
- Jordan: please send BrightReseller's reseller ID and tax doc to camila_reyes@redwood.ai.
- Jordan / Aurelia Procurement: sign the attached proforma so we can lock the billing fields.
- Ben / Vanessa: if you want the commission shown on the invoice, tell me and I'll switch the template (otherwise we'll run as settlement).

I'll be available for a quick call tomorrow 9–11am PT if you want to walk through the workbook.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Channel Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: aur_ppo_pricing.xlsx (spreadsheet), proforma-invoice-draft.pdf (pdf)
